title: fyi: i need to disconnect iphone now.

messages.text: fyi: i need to disconnect iphone now.

OK, go ahead and unplug it now; nothing breaks, and I'm stopping the phone test.

- The countdown heat test (P-130): parts 1-3 are done and valid; part 4 was running and will be marked "interrupted", not counted.
- What's left (part 4 again and part 5) runs when the iPhone is back, or we judge from parts 1-3 if that is enough.
- Until then the Mac and Simulator work goes on; the agents that waited for the phone test to end can start now.
- The phone tests and your swipe steps wait until you're back.

What you need to do: unplug the iPhone; write "phone back" here when it is plugged in again.

Thanks, the iPhone is back and seen by the Mac; the phone tests restart now.

- First: the last two parts of the countdown heat test (P-130), about 15 min.
- Then: the no-backgrounds proof (P-137), now approved, about 25 min.
- Then: your swipe steps (People word Try-it, no-backgrounds swipe pair).
- Heat: unplugging may have switched off Xcode's Serious setting. The test checks it first; if it is off, a step asks you to turn it back on.

What you need to do: nothing unless a step appears in Your steps.
fyi: i was reconnect the wifi and set thermal state as serious.

Thanks: your Serious setting reached the test, and the phone is in use again.
- The heat test (P-130) checked the phone after you pressed Done on the Xcode step in Your steps, and continues with its last 2 parts.
- The Wi-Fi reconnect is fine: our tools look up the Mac's address on the network each time, not from a saved copy.
- Next on the phone: the no-backgrounds test (P-137), now the top priority, then your swipe steps.

What you need to do: nothing now. Please leave the phone and Xcode as they are until the tests end.
